metadata.question: Was the Antarctic ozone hole larger on October 7, 2021 than compared to its area on January 1, 2021?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use Sentinel-5P OFFL O3 product or similar ozone dataset - Need data for two specific dates: 2021-10-07 and 2021-01-01 - Location: Antarctic region (approximately south of 60°S) - The "ozone hole" is defined by Total Column Ozone < 220 Dobson Units 2. Masking strategy: - This question is about ozone, not clouds - Need to identify pixels where ozone < 220 DU (ozone hole definition) - Calculate area of ozone hole for both dates 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: Area calculation succeeds but area is 0 (no ozone hole) - C1: No images found for one or both dates - C2: Images exist but no valid pixels after processing - C3: Calculation returns None/NaN/invalid value - A: October 7 area > January 1 area - B: October 7 area <= January 1 area ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1. Geometry & Time Definitions antarctic = ee.Geometry.Polygon( [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90], [-180, -60]]], None, False ) date1 = '2021-01-01' date2 = '2021-10-07' # 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P Ozone col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') \ .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(antarctic) col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') \ .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) \ .filterBounds(antarctic) size1 = col1.size().getInfo() size2 = col2.size().getInfo() print(f"Jan 1 Images: {size1}") print(f"Oct 7 Images: {size2}") if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0: print("Missing data for one or both dates.") print("C1") else: # 3. Process - Get mean image and identify ozone hole (< 220 DU) img1 = col1.mean() img2 = col2.mean() ozone_band = 'O3_column_number_density' # Convert to Dobson Units (1 DU = 2.69e16 molecules/cm²) # Sentinel-5P provides mol/m², convert: mol/m² * 2241.15 ≈ DU conversion = 2241.15 ozone1_du = img1.select(ozone_band).multiply(conversion) ozone2_du = img2.select(ozone_band).multiply(conversion) # Ozone hole: areas where ozone < 220 DU hole1 = ozone1_du.lt(220) hole2 = ozone2_du.lt(220) # 4. Calculate area (in square km) # Use pixelArea and multiply by mask pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6) # Convert to km² area1_img = hole1.multiply(pixel_area) area2_img = hole2.multiply(pixel_area) result1 = area1_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=antarctic, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) result2 = area2_img.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry=antarctic, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ) area1 = result1.get(ozone_band).getInfo() area2 = result2.get(ozone_band).getInfo() # Check pixel counts count1 = hole1.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=antarctic, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(ozone_band).getInfo() count2 = hole2.reduceRegion( reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=antarctic, scale=5000, maxPixels=1e9 ).get(ozone_band).getInfo() print(f"Jan 1: Pixels={count1}, Hole Area={area1:.0f} km²") print(f"Oct 7: Pixels={count2}, Hole Area={area2:.0f} km²") # 5. Validation & Final Answer if area1 is None or area2 is None or count1 == 0 or count2 == 0: print("Calculation failed or no valid pixels.") if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0: print("C2") else: print("C3") else: if area2 > area1: print("October 7 ozone hole was larger.") print("A") else: print("October 7 ozone hole was NOT larger.") print("B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
antarctic = ee.Geometry.Polygon(
    [[[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, -90], [-180, -90], [-180, -60]]],
    None, False
)

date1 = '2021-01-01'
date2 = '2021-10-07'

# 2. Data Acquisition - Sentinel-5P Ozone
col1 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') \
    .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(antarctic)

col2 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_O3') \
    .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) \
    .filterBounds(antarctic)

size1 = col1.size().getInfo()
size2 = col2.size().getInfo()

print(f"Jan 1 Images: {size1}")
print(f"Oct 7 Images: {size2}")

if size1 == 0 or size2 == 0:
    print("Missing data for one or both dates.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Process - Get mean image and identify ozone hole (< 220 DU)
    img1 = col1.mean()
    img2 = col2.mean()
    
    ozone_band = 'O3_column_number_density'
    
    # Convert to Dobson Units (1 DU = 2.69e16 molecules/cm²)
    # Sentinel-5P provides mol/m², convert: mol/m² * 2241.15 ≈ DU
    conversion = 2241.15
    
    ozone1_du = img1.select(ozone_band).multiply(conversion)
    ozone2_du = img2.select(ozone_band).multiply(conversion)
    
    # Ozone hole: areas where ozone < 220 DU
    hole1 = ozone1_du.lt(220)
    hole2 = ozone2_du.lt(220)
    
    # 4. Calculate area (in square km)
    # Use pixelArea and multiply by mask
    pixel_area = ee.Image.pixelArea().divide(1e6)  # Convert to km²
    
    area1_img = hole1.multiply(pixel_area)
    area2_img = hole2.multiply(pixel_area)
    
    result1 = area1_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=antarctic,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    result2 = area2_img.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry=antarctic,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    )
    
    area1 = result1.get(ozone_band).getInfo()
    area2 = result2.get(ozone_band).getInfo()
    
    # Check pixel counts
    count1 = hole1.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=antarctic,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(ozone_band).getInfo()
    
    count2 = hole2.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=antarctic,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get(ozone_band).getInfo()
    
    print(f"Jan 1: Pixels={count1}, Hole Area={area1:.0f} km²")
    print(f"Oct 7: Pixels={count2}, Hole Area={area2:.0f} km²")
    
    # 5. Validation & Final Answer
    if area1 is None or area2 is None or count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
        print("Calculation failed or no valid pixels.")
        if count1 == 0 or count2 == 0:
            print("<answer>C2</answer>")
        else:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    else:
        if area2 > area1:
            print("October 7 ozone hole was larger.")
            print("<answer>A</answer>")
        else:
            print("October 7 ozone hole was NOT larger.")
            print("<answer>B</answer>")
